full_judgment: 20. In the instant case it is seen that no neighbouring witness being examined and also that there is no corroboration of disinterested witness in the case. It is also seen that most of the cited witnesses were being withheld by the prosecution and none cross-examined those vital witness particularly the Investigating Officer and the seizure list witnesses raises a presumption against the prosecution to the effect that had they been examined in the case they would not have supported the prosecution case and the benefit of such defect will to the accused-person.
